thread:
maria_support: FYI customer ACME reported repeated invoice failures for PO-4821; payment attempts hitting card_decline with mixed reasons. Invoice ID inv_2026_9841, merchant acct: acme-prod.
jason_payments: Can you paste the gateway payload + error codes? If we see ACS behavior we can tell if it's SCA or acquirer-side block. :eyes:
olivia_se: Saw the ticket — customer says retries show a redirect to ACS but then the payer never completes challenge (iframe closed). Sometimes ACS returns NO_CHALLENGE and we still see decline. Logged sample from 2026-03-11 17:02 UTC below.
maria_support: Log excerpt:
```
PAYMENT_ATTEMPT id=pay_9a8b inv=inv_2026_9841 gateway_resp={code: '51', reason: 'Insufficient funds', acquirer_code: '51'}
FOLLOWUP id=pay_9a8c gateway_resp={code: '401', reason: 'ACS_NO_CHALLENGE', acs_status: 'no_challenge'}
```
liam_oncall: Hmm two different terminal reasons on two attempts — first an auth decline (51) then ACS returned no_challenge. Could be card-level decline then 3DS flow falling back to a non-challenge outcome that our client treats as failure.
ops_bot: Trace created: trace_id=trc_e3f4a2. Link: https://console.internal/traces/trc_e3f4a2 :robot_face:
jason_payments: Repro steps request from me: a) use the same merchant/gateway config b) call our /v1/charges with card from the customer's support note (masked) c) set header X-Trace-Id=trc_e3f4a2. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/payments/charge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "X-Trace-Id: trc_e3f4a2" \
  -d '{"amount": 12500, "currency": "usd", "payment_method": {"type":"card","number":"424242XXXX","exp_month":7,"exp_year":2027}}'
```
olivia_se: I ran a controlled retry in sandbox with the trace id. Gateway returned 3DS redirect with html payload, client posted back with status=completed but ACS responded with `no_challenge`. Our client treats `no_challenge` as success in hosted flows, but merchant integration has stricter requirement and marks it failed. There is a mismatch in how merchant's PSP handles NO_CHALLENGE.
maria_support: Customer says provider requires explicit challenge or else it flags as fraud. They saw a velocity/fraud rule block after NO_CHALLENGE attempts.
liam_oncall: Action items:
- Jason: confirm if we should map ACS_NO_CHALLENGE -> PASS for this PSP or leave as conditional.
- Olivia: can you surface a per-attempt payload we can send to merchant support so they see acquirer decision? Include acq_code and 3ds_status.
- Maria: advise customer to temporarily allow NO_CHALLENGE or add alternate payment method until we fix.
jason_payments: Quick fix option: on retries, prefer a non-3DS auth endpoint (if PSP supports) or re-route to fallback gateway that performs a standard auth-only (no 3DS). I'll audit routing rules for acme-prod.
olivia_se: Added the per-attempt JSON to the support ticket (ticket# 5621) with acquirer trace and network logs. Snippet we shared with merchant:
```
{
  "attempt_id": "pay_9a8c",
  "acquirer_code": "401",
  "3ds_status": "no_challenge",
  "acs_url": "https://acs.acquirer/tp/xyz",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-11T17:02:12Z"
}
```
maria_support: Customer asked if this is a platform regression — they saw normal success last month. Any config change? jason_payments?
jason_payments: No platform-wide change. We did deploy routing tweak to prefer 3DS for high-risk BINs two weeks ago, but that wouldn't flip NO_CHALLENGE semantics. I'll check gateway flags and merchant-specific routing overrides.
liam_oncall: Also check if this card previously had a saved token with different billing address/AVS mismatch — many fraud holds are triggered by AVS/CVC. Can we surface AVS/CVV reason in the failed attempts UI for support?
olivia_se: We have CVV/AVS in logs but not surfaced. I'll add a support-only column in the payments debug view and drop a short patch for QA tomorrow.
maria_support: Customer accepted short-term workaround: they will whitelist our acquirer result and ask their PSP to treat NO_CHALLENGE as non-fatal for a day while we investigate. They requested ETA on permanent fix.
jason_payments: ETA: 48h to confirm routing rules and add conditional mapping for this PSP. If acquirer insists NO_CHALLENGE should be treated as decline for liability reasons, we can add a merchant-level flag to override default success mapping. I'll follow up in this thread when I have confirmation. :thumbsup:
liam_oncall: If we need immediate unblock, support can manually re-run a single auth with 10 USD hold on a different card to capture payment while we sort this.
ops_bot: Deploy scheduled: payments-routing v1.4.3 to canary in 2h (not yet applied to acme-prod). :package:
maria_support: Thanks team — I've updated ACME ticket and set expectation. leaving thread open until routing flag confirmed. :white_check_mark:
